sources.purpose: Exact part/order identity and official STEP link
Manufacturer CAD; downloaded only, not imported or mechanically inspected yet

visual_review.confirmed: d1/d2/L/d3/w labels, M2 row and L+1mm minimum blind hole diagram

current_reference_interface.basis: Width-review native pilot-axis and selected-section inventory, to be rebound at exact eventual adoption

required_before_adoption: Inspect official STEP dimensions and exact assembly axis; published dimensions are nominal without a complete tolerance envelope.
Inventory every affected insert occurrence and preserve actual part counts and remaining generic references.
Distinguish pre-installation printed pilot from installed heat-set cavity; any deliberate material interference must be exactly paired and quantified, not globally ignored.
Check boss wall after installation, blind hole depth, screw tip clearance and thread engagement for each affected location.
Run local native interference/section/tool/removal checks after any targeted printed-web change.
Use PLA/PETG coupons to qualify actual printed holes, insertion conditions, retention and repeated servicing before print release.
